title: UniversalSmp mod
description: A mod for an UniversalSmp (an smp between friends)
body:
![This is regular pvp, tired of it ? then this mod is for you!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b715e2a4fbb053186ed2499ac3b9ff09961ed0e0_0.webp)

This mod was created to have a bunch of modded stuff for smps.

main stuff: 

Dragonized scythe: the most powerfull weapon obtainable, only one craftable

Scythes: Yeah just scythes what'd you expect ?

Syringues : tired the damages are too low ? just use brecopoison, it doubles the damage

Anti-Runner enchants : tired of runers ? just enchant with pullback

other stuff:

Ghost death: turns you into a blind ghost to search for a plant called "Flower of life", only this shall revive you (its off by default so use /gamerule ghostdeath true)
